note: Design requirements from the v3 brief, Section 3. Each traces to a finding; DR IDs are used in the provenance fields of the other content files.

requirements.finding: Educator capacity, not technology, appears to be the binding constraint
requirements.requirement: The platform targets educators, not students, and treats capacity as institutionally conditioned.

requirements.finding: Standards specifying student outcomes without institutional conditions act as exhortation
requirements.requirement: Profile institutional conditions alongside individual practice (A3).

requirements.finding: The only controlled study testing explainable AI in novice clinicians found automation bias
requirements.source: Study 1, Tier 4 [AYMAN TO SUPPLY: Table 1 ID]
requirements.requirement: Scenario SC1; the coach invites critique of its own output (A7).

requirements.finding: The only RCT in the corpus found no transfer of AI training to unaided performance
requirements.source: Study 1, Tier 4 [AYMAN TO SUPPLY: Table 1 ID]
requirements.requirement: Scenario SC2; practice evidence asks about performance without the tool (A6).

requirements.finding: Foundational AI literacy has the most defensible evidence base; applied clinical competencies do not yet
requirements.requirement: Coach and scenarios prioritise literacy-level change and avoid overclaiming applied outcomes (A7, SC4).

requirements.finding: No included intervention reached behaviour change in practice or patient outcomes
requirements.requirement: The platform captures enacted practice and its consequences, not only attitudes (A6).

requirements.finding: The risk of ceremonial compliance under accreditation pressure
requirements.requirement: No certificates; a decoupling probe item; scenario SC3 (A3, A6).

requirements.finding: Design must be revisable from Studies 2–3 and the Delphi
requirements.requirement: All content in versioned data files with provenance (A1).
